post_title: What will the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) close at on Friday, November 27, 2026?

question.title: What will the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) close at on Friday, November 27, 2026?
question.description:
The Nasdaq Composite (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasdaq_Composite) is a market-capitalization-weighted index of roughly 3,400 securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market, heavily weighted toward technology and growth companies, and is one of the three major US equity benchmarks alongside the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average.

Status as of November 13, 2026: the index closed at 24,922.08, down 444.01 points (-1.75%) on the day, after closing at 25,366.09 on November 12. The November 13 session ranged from a low of 24,888.98 to a high of 25,423.09, and the index's one-year return stands at +10.91% (https://indexes.nasdaq.com/Index/Overview/COMP). The index is therefore sitting just below the round 25,000 level, which it has traded on both sides of in recent sessions.

Market backdrop: US equities have been whipsawed by two forces. First, the AI trade. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced his resignation effective immediately on November 12 amid scrutiny of a personal relationship, and NVDA fell about 4% that day (after being down as much as 14% intraday), leaving its market capitalization hovering near the $4 trillion mark (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-nvda-jensen-huang-second-affair.html). CoreWeave's earnings drove a sharp AI-linked rebound on November 11, and Anthropic - which launched its IPO roadshow on November 10, prices its offering on November 18 and begins trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19 at an implied valuation of roughly $1.3-1.45 trillion - is a further potential swing factor before the question's resolution date (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/anthropic-ipo-claude-maker-to-begin-trading-on-thursday-nov-19-173550865/). Second, monetary policy. October CPI, published November 10, rose 0.4% month-on-month with core CPI up 0.3%, both above expectations; markets fully price a Fed rate hike at the December meeting, some officials have floated a 50bp move, and the 10-year Treasury yield is around 5.1% (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/cpi-inflation-report-october-2026.html).

Volatility: the VIX closed at 17.49 on November 11 after touching an eight-month high near 28 the prior week and sits close to its 2026 average of roughly 18 (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/VIXCLS). Recent daily index moves include +1.7% on November 11 and -1.75% on November 13, and the index's 52-week range is wide enough that a several-hundred-point move over the coming two weeks is a realistic scenario in either direction.

Calendar: Thursday, November 26, 2026 is Thanksgiving, and US equity markets are closed that day. Friday, November 27, 2026 is a shortened session that closes at 1:00 p.m. ET (https://www.investopedia.com/is-the-stock-market-open-on-veterans-day-2026-trading-holidays-12239907). No first-tier US macro releases are scheduled for November 26-27: October PCE and the second estimate of Q3 GDP land on November 25, the November employment report on December 4, November CPI on December 10, and the FOMC decision on December 9. Post-Thanksgiving half-day volume is typically thin, which can amplify index moves.

The resolving value is the official close for the November 27 session, available in Yahoo Finance's ^IXIC historical table (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EIXIC/history/), with Nasdaq's own index history page as fallback (https://indexes.nasdaq.com/Index/History/COMP).

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing value of the Nasdaq Composite Index (ticker ^IXIC; Nasdaq index code COMP) for the regular trading session of Friday, November 27, 2026, expressed in index points, as given in the "Close" column of the row dated Nov 27, 2026 in Yahoo Finance's historical price table for ^IXIC (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EIXIC/history/). For example, a close of 25,214.87 resolves as 25214.87. Nasdaq's regular session on Friday, November 27, 2026 is a shortened post-Thanksgiving session ending at 1:00 p.m. ET (18:00 UTC); the closing value of that shortened session is the value used, and no after-hours or extended-hours trading counts. If Yahoo Finance shows no closing value for that date, the closing index value published by Nasdaq for the same session at https://indexes.nasdaq.com/Index/History/COMP will be used instead.
question.fine_print: If the Nasdaq Composite's regular session on November 27, 2026 does not take place at all (for example, a market-wide closure), the question is annulled.
